question: What Is a Tri State Buffer?
body_html:
A tri state buffer is a logic buffer whose output can be high, low or high impedance (Z). When enabled it copies the input, and when disabled it disconnects from the line so other chips can share the bus.

Enable (active low)InputOutput
LLL, drives low
LHH, drives high
HXZ, high impedance

Only one buffer on a bus may be enabled at a time to avoid contention.
